description: This file defines the 'WrapSubContentCacheTransform' class, which is a FreeMarker TemplateTransformModel used for manipulating content URLs and wrapping content within FreeMarker templates in the Apache OFBiz framework.

classes.name: WrapSubContentCacheTransform
classes.description: A FreeMarker transform that wraps content URLs or sections within templates, enabling dynamic content manipulation.

methods.name: getWriter
methods.description: Returns a Writer that processes the output of the transform, capturing the content and rendering nested templates if a wrapTemplateId is specified.

methods.name: getWrappedObject
methods.description: Deprecated method for obtaining wrapped objects from the environment context.

methods.name: getArg
methods.description: Deprecated method for retrieving arguments passed to the transform.
